Party Hard v1.4.035.r; 17 May 2018, 3:00 a.m.

notes.title: Darius's Changelog: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/b27e14b72992131785e73e6344224bd69f2dfe37.gif

 PartyHard v1.4.031; 17 Jul 2017, 2:59 a.m.

  Dear Log!

 It's Darius again. They stopped him. Finally. Should I say "fixed" instead? Nonetheless, he won't take a life anymore. Just listen to me and you will understand. 

1. That police officer in the Porn Studio... (I'm talking about  High Crimes DLC level) So, you take out everyone—every single shnockered punk—, the victory over everlasting party insanity is within your reach; you are just about to leave... and but a second away that cop takes you down brutally. While he absolutely shouldn't! It wasn't even fair, to be completely frank. Well, the developers found out about this so called "software bug", took measures and fixed this issue  for good. Now this brute of a law employee only takes you  out, and then you proceed to the next stage. Finally, some justice is done. But when you think about all of those innocent people he had killed... Makes me sick. Don't look at me that way.
---------------------------------------------------------------
2. "Justice will be served (even if it's cold)" is the motto of this night's Changelog. Timer on the Boat level is now in working order and shows you the  right time you've actually spent beating it. Respective achievements now unlock properly too. I'm satasfied, my Dear Log.

 And with that constant noise coming from the neighbouring building I am not.

notes.notes:

 10 Jul 2017, 2:59 a.m.

  Dear Log!

 I'm so sorry to wake you up this late. This entry is going to take only five minutes of your time. I know it was  two minutes five minutes ago, but... this is crucial, so hear me out.

New language has been added to Party Hard - Turkish. Now 80+ millions native speakers across the globe can finally play the game courtesy of my loyal fan Mehmet Barut. They say "Thank you" to  Mehmet  as well as the devs. Well, of course the devs  do. I mean, why wouldn't they, my dear Log? That diligent  adam saved them a whole damn bunch of time ctrl+c\ctrl-v'ing with the G-Translate. 

 Anyways, that's it for now, dear Log. Please, forgive me for being too mean. I just haven't got no decent sleep recently. Darn partying morons make me jumpy. Too jumpy sometimes...

notes.title: Darius's Changelog: Updated main menu
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/47281e39c340108fe7894dd2bfd28bf5f158c456.jpg
( Base image by  Zennore http://zennore.deviantart.com/ )

 PartyHard v1.4.030; 9 Jun 2017, 2:59 a.m.

  Dear Log!

 Crucial changes are being made to Party Hard. It's been bugging me so much, I just can't take it out of my head. Got to tell someone. Or better write it down in my log. You, that is.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/de3f5c380d816666a5dce2245ca23f422e2db37c.jpg
 1. An old main menu background (that really tied the game together) is gone.  Devs say they replaced it because it had caused the game to go all blackscreen sometimes. I believe them.
So, now we've got a new main menu background. It's still good old look out of the window but now it's like this:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/5761b9fd654f2d5eb7f765325ceb8bd531878c62.jpg
 Devs say they have moved from one place where cars drive by all the time at low framerate to another where some guy tries to get some sleep at 3:00 a.m. As far as this statement goes, I doubt they're telling the truth. I smell some kind of... something.
---------------------------------------------------------------
 2. Local co-op is now unavailable for those who haven't beat the tutorial. Sounds too cruel to me. It's like not allowing people who listen to Nickelback to reproduce. Wait...
---------------------------------------------------------------
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/ec6e342f213ba1e9115fc1cbedda2f0b6507a1e3.jpg
 3. Fonts in main menu have been improved. Now their shadows display the way they should and don't switch layers, but... There had been something about the old buggy fonts that I just can't forget. Call me retrograde as much as you want.
---------------------------------------------------------------
 4. Sometimes in order to quit the game you had to hover and click the "QUIT" button twice. Devs have fixed this to "save your precious time". I think they shouldn't have. Because it had taught you how not to be a puny quitter. But hey, who listens to me anyway...
---------------------------------------------------------------
 Well, that's it for now, Dear Log. It's late and I need to get some sleep, but I just can't. That godd/\mn noise just won't let me sleep a freaking wink. Gotta do something about it.

notes.title: Huge Workshop Update: new levels, surveillance cams and more!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/cba2a7b0ba16de9034a27162238c100fe9a765a6.png
  (Image by:  EyesOfSemicolon)

  What's cracking, party tribe! 

We know, we missed you too. And while you have been partying hard, we've been working. HARD! You're lucky we love you too much. Because not only we're not mad at cha for your laziness, but we are even upgrading the in-game Level Editor for you! Here's your detailed  Upgrade Guide.

ːpartyknifeːNEW BACKGROUNDS 
 (Where this new stuff is:  CONSTRUCTION / BACKGROUNDS)
Dark Castle, Porn Studio, Skyscraper, Police Department. What do these levels have in common? Correct, Albert: they scroll. But as advanced as those maps may be... they are not true scrolling levels until you can edit them. And  now  you can—via the Workshop. 
----------------
 Dark Castle: 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/d797823bd79fac3882e84606fe41849f18bfb05e.gif
Deep in the Carpathians stands an old mysterious castle... When the sun dies over it, evil claims its reign inside. Vile creatures crawl out from under ancient tombstones to begin their blasphemous banquet. And it is you who holds this banquet!
-----------------
 Porn Studio: 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/7ab941a82f5f2e904dcff83bda802ffc7092a870.gif
Someone's trying to get some sleep? Them fools can forget it! Because you are filming some adult junk and raving out loud at the same time right around the bend. Studio is a perfect playground for you to have fun with your toys...ːpartylipsː
----------------
 Skyscraper: 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/8e629f4904323c8f56fa7baddb2b8e4700ca5753.gif
Throw a crazy party in a  Die Hard setting and then slaughter every human / animal / alien you've put in there. If you are scared of heights, let your friends tackle the issue.
-------------------
 Police Department: 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/f7c3be7dd6715a499ef59fdf117b8e63f643cf70.gif
Creating a prison to be locked in? Even Houdini couldn't have dreamt of such a luxury. Turning a police station into a bullfighting arena in not a pipe dream anymore.

ːpartypoliceːSURVEILLANCE CAMERAS
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/ddce20899cc715eb8e52e29143442fef1d147e38.gif
 (Where this new stuff is: Surv. cameras:  FURNITURE / EQUIPMENT; Surv. guards:  PEOPLE / SPECIAL)
Say you think  Party Hard isn't hard enough. [spoiler]sounds a bit far-fetched[/spoiler] Suit yourself and make it harder by placing survaillance cams all over the place. But, please, don't cry when security manhandles you.

ːpartymaskːDOORS, LOCKED WITH KEYS
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/124cbd8968cdbf9419284a2138f46904eee74cca.gif
 (Where this new stuff is: Doors:  CONSTRUCTION / STRUCTURE; Keys:  TRAPS / ITEMS)
Same here. Bring some logic to the table, make some doors actually  locked (authentic experience) and [strike] swallow [/strike] place the keys near an angry dog.

ːpartypillsːNEW WALLS, NEW TILE AND OTHER NEW STUFF
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/7cb67c379fab9e4b1f55d71e539b02a373fb3c24.png http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/a6dc9365be7ce28433d3d1631fa53f2e10d72422.png
 (Where this new stuff is: Walls:  CONSTRUCTION / WALLS, Tile:  CONSTRUCTION / FLOOR) 
Go old-school with chain-link fencing, honor Pink Floyd with a classic white brick wall, and create penitentiary vibe using a barbed wire barrier. 

ːpartydiskːBUG FIXES
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/384c8af2d01e64bca553bc253045a52393cc54e9.gif
Once upon a time there was a wicked bug. It caused the game to crash when the brave party killer plugged in his faithful  controller. It has been fixed. End of the fairy tale. 

We've also fixed a bunch of other minor issues too so game's gotten even better. 

-----------------
Well, that's kinda it for the guide. We hope you'll have a lot of fun with the upgraded Workshop and with the game in general!

 Happy partying right there!ːwaterː

notes.title: Day One Patch (High Crimes DLC)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/af9e9436ec89d136f657f8960c7acbb24b590e28.jpg
Image by Zennore (@ZennyTheGreat)

Hi, everyone! Thanks for your support and for helping us make Party Hard better. Thanks to your feedback we were able to find and fix a few major and some minor bugs in this update. We are still working on local co-op, an update for it will come shortly as well. Here are some noticeable fixes:

* Fixed and added a few more behaviors to the final boss (High Crimes DLC)

* Cop shooting (High Crimes DLC) sometimes didn`t work properly, fixed

* Getting stuck in hiding objects (High Crimes DLC), fixed

* "Not flagging characters upon completing the level" bug, fixed

* Fixed objectives that wouldn't update properly

* Menu DLC selection. Sometimes you started a standard campaign when choosing "DLC" option, fixed

* A few minor tweaks to animations (like a character that continued to walk while using elevators etc.)

* A minor graphics improvements and optimizations (High Crimes DLC)

* Local co-op fixes (still needs some improvements)

* Fixed and added a few more behaviors to the final boss (High Crimes DLC)

* Cop shooting (High Crimes DLC) sometimes didn`t work properly, fixed

* Getting stuck in hiding objects (High Crimes DLC), fixed

* "Not flagging characters upon completing the level" bug, fixed

* Fixed objectives that wouldn't update properly

* Menu DLC selection. Sometimes you started a standard campaign when choosing "DLC" option, fixed

* A few minor tweaks to animations (like a character that continued to walk while using elevators etc.)

* A minor graphics improvements and optimizations (High Crimes DLC)

* Local co-op fixes (still needs some improvements)

notes.title: Huge performance update is live
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/QVOpx4S.png

 Oh, hi! 

Yes, we are still working on Party Hard. This update makes sure we are able to add more content later and allows us to release on more platforms. 

Performance update

A huge performance update for Party Hard is now live. It addresses multiple issues that impact framerate, and should result in a much smoother experience, especially in terms of loading times. 

It's a little-known fact that Party Hard has been developed in record time (only about 6 months), while it should've been an 18 month-development project. The game was being designed on the go with real-time feedback, and resulted in what we have now. We spent the last month on refactoring the game's code to enable it to run on more platforms. 

 Kindle Fire TV release

During the development we've had tons of help from  Amazon, so the first non-desktop platform we're releasing on is Kindle Fire TV. The game is now available at http://www.amazon.com/tinyBuild-Party-Hard/dp/B01868JZDK/ref=sr_1_8?ie=UTF8&qid=1448035309&sr=8-8&keywords=party+hard 

Working on a Level Editor

The team at Pinokl is hard at work on a Level Editor for Party Hard. Progress is being made, but no ETA yet.

We MAY or MAY NOT be working on a console version

We can neither confirm nor deny the possibility of bringing Party Hard to consoles.

notes.title: After Party update adds 7 parties, for FREE
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/CmId5Qh.gif

Yes, that GIF shows exactly what you think it does. Aside from giant alien butts that shoot rainbows, the After Party update adds 7 new levels! 

These include variations on existing parties, completely new game modes, and some really strange things. To be honest, I'm not exactly sure how the guys at Pinokl facilitate their creative process, but it's definitely working!

At some point in developing the update Igor showed me the GIF above and asked if that was too much. I gave it some thought and realized: it is never too much with Party Hard. So expect more weirdness!

Here's the trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?t=94&v=xC6lox490zk
New parties
Robot party with UFOs!
A psychodelic party with giant duck boats, rainbows... and aliens
A zombie apocalypse, be-e-e-ecause every game is better with a zombie mode in it  (c)  Activision
The Vegas Casino party... on steroids. And SWAT teams. And a dozen of body guards
Why not party on a boat... WHILE IT'S SINKING?!
A party on a spaceship with aliens!
A really weird Halloween party, you'll know what I mean

The changelog of fixes (the main game)
Fixed common problems with gamepads
Fixed the full-screen issues that sometimes made the game switch to windowed mode
Solved rare saving issues
No more crashes during Twitch streams
Updated language menu
Bodyguard glitches tweaked
Fixed the dance floor grenade collider issue
Fixed shark attack glitches
Fixed a rare crash on the Halloween party level
 Enjoy the AfterParty!

Edit: Just published a hotfix that should open all the levels for people who have beaten the game.

notes.title: Did anyone order a Sharknado? Patch 1 notes
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/igAja5h.gif

- Added Sharknado to the Miami Party as a Twitch event
- Fixed achievement bugs
- Fixed ninja's stealth ability not working properly sometimes
- New Twitch events
- Upgraded AI
- Rebalanced Halloween and Vegas levels
- Watched Angry Joe play  Party Hard for 9 hours straight, including over 2 hours on the Miami Party
- Purposely not fixing the difficulty spike in the Miami party
- Added time scoring when you complete levels
- Fixed some issues with score multipliers
- Showed off Party Hard on the Twitch stage at PAX Prime
- Thought it would be a great idea to have fake knives that collapse at PAX. Quickly realized it's a bad idea to run around with realistic-looking knives stabbing people (they also leave bruises)
- Thought it'd be a good idea to have a bubble machine at PAX Prime, realized it's a bad idea when I accidentally sprayed a 2 feet high layer of bubbles all over PAX 10, 505 games, and Adult Swim's booths. But hey, it was clean! 
- Thought it'd be a good idea to have a fog machine in our booth. Tested it. Who knew fog machines trigger smoke alarms? (apparently everyone but me!)
- Fixed a rare issue when the game would launch right into a black screen. It had everything to do with corrupt save files
- The cop player character can now use shortcuts
-  Party Hard is our most fun game launch
- Major content update coming very soon!
